high_level_description: The image is an infographic provided by Northrop Grumman, detailing the components of one of their solid rocket boosters used for NASA's Space Launch System (SLS). The infographic is structured to highlight various parts of the booster, with labels and descriptions for each section. Title and Context: The text at the top mentions that while the motor performed well through harsh environments during testing, there was an anomaly near the end of the two-minute burn. This test, as part of the Artemis program, provides valuable data for future developments.
